reasons.reader_question: Two sharp gaps: who holds the lens on Ewe's Rest, and what his uncle did when Kunal was nine.
reasons.change: Kunal moves from trusting song-secrecy to doubting it. Dhanu's party leaves, the pair are alone, and a watcher is found.
reasons.romance_movement: This is a new reason. Ila declines the half-answer without taking its use, and he starts an uncalculated disclosure for the first time.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Held gazes, her read of his bare fingers, and 'I'll take the half' with nothing written. All shown through action.
reasons.character_logic: Kunal calls Ila his door to crown knowledge while saying she hasn't seen the clause. Dhanu lets the gap pass.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: The 'turn back to guard the hamlets' option is never voiced. The glint threatens an empty house, so no loved person is named.
reasons.prose: Clean and concrete with no banned phrases. 'Something in him had come loose' and the pewter sky are stock. The 'bright line' echo is slightly overused.
reasons.continuity: Matches F470-F476, F431/F471, F451, the ch7 'nine, alone' line, Mini's age and the 315-degree glint. No conflicts found.

fixes: At 'the only door I have into what the crown knows': this is irrational behaviour. Kunal has just said Ila hasn't seen the clause. Have Dhanu say so ('She doesn't know it either'). Kunal should give a sharper reason: what she is ordered to measure, and where she stops, will show what the crown is looking for. That keeps him smart and keeps the values collision honest.

At 'We'll stock the lake huts and sit on the high ground': the stakes have no depth because the beat's 'turn back to guard the hamlets' option is missing. Have Dhanu ask Kunal to stay and watch Ewe's Rest and the upper fold. Kunal refuses for the Hollow Moon. Then at the glint, have Kunal see that the short way Dhanu, Gauri and Mini took lies under that outcrop's view, so the watcher threatens a named child.

At 'Something in him had come loose and was running': this narrates the turn instead of showing it. Cut the list of reasons ('she had been kind... taught her to count') to one concrete trigger on the cliff. For example, Ila says 'A man would' back to him in Mini's voice, or lowers the compass to look at him. The uncalculated start then happens in response to an action, not a summary.
reader_question: Who is watching Ewe's Rest through a spyglass, and what did Kunal's uncle do to him when he was nine?
new_facts_assessment: The draft lists no new facts. Ch8 facts already sit in continuity as F470-F476 and match the page. Unlisted additions: (1) the short way under the snow-line needs no rope, which is plausible but should be logged as a magic fact; (2) Kunal taught Mini the Stair song, consistent with F433; (3) Hari is named as the source of the chalk, consistent with F451/F453. C04 (the horn worn against the skin, 'off a cold man') is planted memorably.
